method: The last observed snapshot of each game-update counter is retained for movement and animation measurements. Movement aggregates only positive-VBlank adjacent update intervals with unchanged published and desired gait at both endpoints. Connie additionally requires mode 10 and unchanged target. Distances use X/Z. Animation unwrapping uses phase + clip end * repeat counter within segments of unchanged gait, mode, clip, rate and state; clip start/end were independently read from the same-scene RAM dump. Gait transitions use the first raw sample observing the new state. Capture is asynchronous; transition timing is bounded by sampling/update granularity. Initial saved-state idle rate 2 persists until a fresh transition, so that short stale interval is separate. Animation segments exclude the initial unchanged parent phase during clip blending: the playback measurement starts at the snapshot immediately preceding its first observed phase advance.
